meta.about: Words the curated content uses that Wiktionary lacks (companion/bin/lexicon-build --coverage lists them); the usual reading of a few frequent forms (je, sem, si, vas, hvala) so it comes first; words Wiktionary knows only as a form of another word (prav: never the adverb, only a genitive plural of pravo), which --coverage lists too; the expressions of the content (ravno prav, lahko noč, ni za kaj), which a lookup finds around the tapped word; and, marked override, better glosses for lemmas whose Wiktionary gloss starts with a rare sense (babica: midwife). Names and pure interjections are left out: the villagers' names come from the cast.
